ui.lib.arcade.noHint: Ma jiro dhaqaaq waxtar leh oo haray. Soo qaado kaar, qaybi saf cusub ama dib u bilow.
ui.lib.arcade.note.2048: Isticmaal furayaasha fallaarta ama ku jiid si aad u dhaqaajiso dhammaan tiirarka. Laba tiir oo isku nambar ah way isku darmaan marka ay is taabtaan. Samee tiir la mid ah bartilmaameedka si aad u gudubto heerka; haddii aan tiir dhaqaaqi karin, waad guuldarraysatay.
ui.lib.arcade.note.blocks: Wareeji oo dhig qaybaha dhacaya si aad u buuxiso xariiqyada jiifka ah; xariiqyada buuxa way baaba'aan. ← → dhaqaaji, ↑ wareeji, ↓ si dhakhso ah u dhig, Booska isla markiiba wuu ridaa, P hakad. Nadiifi tirada xariiqyada loo baahan yahay si aad u gudubto heerka; haddii qaybuhu gaaraan sare, waad guuldarraysatay.
ui.lib.arcade.note.breakout: Dhaqaaji jiirka, farta ku jiid garoonka ama isticmaal ← → si aad u hagto sabuuradda oo kubadda ciyaarta ugu haysid. Burburi dhammaan leebka si aad u gudubto heerka; leebka cidhifkoodu qaro weyn yahay waxay u baahan yihiin laba garaac. Waxaad leedahay 3 nolol. Boosku wuu bilaabaa ama hakiyaa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.connect4: Waxaad ciyaaraysaa casaanka oo adigaa horreeya. Taabo tiir si aad u ridiso saxan; wuxuu ku dhacaa meesha bannaan ee ugu hoosaysa. Kii ugu horreeya ee saf ka dhiga 4 saxan oo jiif, taagan ama xagal ah ayaa guuleysta.
ui.lib.arcade.note.freecell: Dhammaan kaararku way furan yihiin. U guuri dhammaan 52-ka kaar 4-ta saldhig nooc ahaan, laga bilaabo A ilaa K. Miiska dusheeda, hoos u dhis adigoo midabada isweydaarsanaya. Unug kasta oo bannaan oo bidixda sare ku yaal wuxuu haystaa hal kaar; inta kaar ee aad mar keliya guurin karto waxay ku xidhan tahay unugyada bannaan iyo tiirarka madhan. Heerarka sare unugyo yar ayay leeyihiin.
ui.lib.arcade.note.gomoku: Waxaad ciyaaraysaa X oo adigaa horreeya; kombiyuutarku wuxuu ciyaarayaa O. Is daba-joog calaamad u dhiga bar bannaan oo ku taal sabuuradda 15×15. Kii ugu horreeya ee hela 5 saf ah oo jiif, taagan ama xagal ah ayaa guuleysta.
ui.lib.arcade.note.klondike: U guuri dhammaan 52-ka kaar 4-ta saldhig nooc ahaan, laga bilaabo A ilaa K. Miiska dusheeda, hoos u dhis adigoo midabada isweydaarsanaya; K oo keliya ayaa geli kara tiir madhan. Taabo tuulada xidhan ee bidixda sare si aad kaararka u soo qaadato. Taabo kaar kadibna meesha aad rabto inaad dhigto, ama mar kale taabo si uu iskiis ugu tago meel sax ah. Heerarka 1–5: soo qaado 1; heerarka 6–10: soo qaado 3.
ui.lib.arcade.note.match3: Isweydaarsii laba qaybood oo dariska ah (taabo mid kadibna kan kale, ama jiid) si aad u samayso saf 3 ama ka badan oo isku mid ah; safku wuu qarxaa, qaybaha ka sarreeyana way dhacaan. Falcelinta silsiladda ah ayaa dhibcahaaga laba-jibbaarta. Gaadh dhibcaha bartilmaameedka ka hor inta aysan dhaqaaqyadu dhammaan.
ui.lib.arcade.note.minesweeper: Taabo unug si aad u furto. Nambarku wuxuu muujinayaa inta miino ee ku jirta 8-da unug ee ku wareegsan. Ku calaamadee miino laga shakisan yahay riixid midig, taabasho dheer ama habka calanka. Taabo nambar ay hore ugu wareegsan yihiin calammo ku filan si aad dhakhso ugu furto inta kale. Fur dhammaan unugyada aan miino lahayn si aad u guuleysato.
ui.lib.arcade.note.reversi: Waxaad ciyaaraysaa madowga oo adigaa horreeya. Dhig saxan si uu u xannibo hal ama dhowr saxan oo cad oo u dhexeeya isaga iyo saxan kale oo madow (jiif, taagan ama xagal); saxannada la xannibay waxay isu beddelaan midabkaaga. Haddii aadan lahayn dhaqaaq sax ah, doorkaaga waad dhaafaysaa. Marka sabuuraddu buuxsanto, kan saxannada badan leh ayaa guuleysta.
ui.lib.arcade.note.snake: Ku hag abeesada furayaasha fallaarta, WASD, badhamada hoose ama jiidis. Cun cuntada casaanka ah si aad u korto; gaadh dhererka loo baahan yahay si aad u gudubto heerka. Laga bilaabo heerka 3, ku dhicitaanka derbiga ciyaarta wuu dhammeeyaa; heerarka sare waxay leeyihiin caqabado. Ha ku dhicin dabadaada.
ui.lib.arcade.note.spider: Miiska dusheeda, nooc kasta ka dhis taxane laga bilaabo K hoos ilaa A; taxanaha dhammaystiran ee 13 kaar si toos ah ayaa looga saaraa. Kaar kasta wuxuu dul fadhiisan karaa kaar hal darajo ka sarreeya, laakiin taxanaha isku nooca ah oo keliya ayaa wada dhaqaaqa. Haddii aad xayiran tahay, taabo Qaybi saf cusub (tiir kasta waa inuu kaar leeyahay). Heerarka 1–3: hal nooc; 4–7: laba; 8–10: afar.
ui.lib.arcade.shuffled: Dhaqaaq ma harin — sabuuradda dib ayaa loo qasay.
ui.lib.arcade.noHintFc: Ma jiro dhaqaaq waxtar leh oo haray. Dib u celi dhowr dhaqaaq ama dib u bilow.
ui.lib.arcade.hintDraw: Lammaane kale ma harin. Guji xirmada si aad kaarka u qaaddo.
ui.lib.arcade.note.blackjack: Lacag ciyaar oo kaliya — maaha lacag dhab ah. Waxaad bilaabaysaa 500 jeeto; gaar tirada jeetooyinka bartilmaameedka ah gacmaha la ogolyahay gudahood si aad heerka u gudubto. U dhowaw 21 in ka badan qaybiyaha adigoon dhaafin. Qaybiyuhu wuu qaadaa kaararka ilaa uu gaaro 17. Blackjack (Ace iyo kaar qiimihiisu toban yahay) wuxuu bixiyaa wax dheeraad ah. Laban laab: waxaad labanlaabtaa ciyaarta oo waxaad qaadataa hal kaar oo keliya. Kala qaybi: waa suurtogal marka laba kaar ee ugu horreeya qiimo isku mid ah leeyihiin.
ui.lib.arcade.note.videopoker: Lacag ciyaar oo kaliya — maaha lacag dhab ah. Dooro ciyaar 1–5 jeeto ah, taabo Qaybi si aad shan kaar u hesho, guji kaararka aad rabto inaad haysato, kaddibna taabo Qaad si aad kuwa kale u beddesho. Lammaane Jack ah ama ka sii wanaagsan ayaa lacag bixiya. Waxaad bilaabaysaa 100 jeeto; gaar tirada jeetooyinka bartilmaameedka ah gacmaha la ogolyahay gudahood si aad heerka u gudubto.
ui.lib.arcade.note.checkers: Waxaad ciyaartaa Casaan (hoose) oo aad horeysaa. Xabbad waxay u dhaqaaqdaa hal square oo jiif ah hore gaar ah square madhan. Haddii aad xabbadda khasmiga ka boodi karto, waa inaad boodaa, waxaadna sii wadi kartaa boodka si aad xabbado badan u qabato. Xabbadda gaadha safka ugu dambeeya waxay noqotaa boqor oo dib ayay u dhaqaaqi kartaa una qabsan kartaa. Waad ku guuldareysataa marka aadan haysan xabbado ama dhaqdhaqaaq sharci ah.
ui.lib.arcade.ckWin: Madaxa Madow dhaqdhaqaaq sharci ah ma laha — waad guulaysatay.
ui.lib.arcade.ckLose: Dhaqdhaqaaq sharci ah ma lihid — waad lumisay.
ui.lib.arcade.ckMust: Waa inaad qabataa marka aad awooddo — dooro mid ka mid ah xabbadaha dhalaalaya.
ui.lib.arcade.note.oanquan: Ciyaar dhaqameed Vietnam. Safka hoose waa kaaga, safka sare waa kombuyuutarka, labada darafna waa laba square oo Mandarin ah. Guji mid ka mid ah square-yadaada kadibna dooro jiho: dhagaxyada oo dhan waa la qaadaa lana beeraa mid mid square kasta. Kadib beerista, haddii square-ka xiga uu dhagaxyo leeyahay, qaad oo sii beer; haddii square-ka xiga madhan yahay kan ka dambeeyana uu dhagaxyo ama Mandarin leeyahay, waad qabataa (waxaadna sii qabataa haddii square madhan uu raaco mid buuxa). Waxaad istaagtaa square-ka Mandarin ama kadib laba square oo madhan oo is xigta. Mandarin wuxuu leeyahay 10 dhibcood, dhagaxna 1. Haddii dhinaca aad dhagaxyo ka dhamaadaan, 5 dhibcood oo aad qabatay ayaa dib loo beeraa. Ciyaartu waxay dhamaanaysaa marka labada Mandarin la qabto; ciyaaryahanka dhibcaha badan leh ayaa guulaysta.
ui.lib.arcade.oqWin: Ciyaartii way dhammaatay — dhibco badan ayaad leedahay.
ui.lib.arcade.oqLose: Ciyaartii way dhammaatay — kombuyuutarku dhibco badan ayuu leeyahay.
ui.lib.arcade.note.ludo: Waxaad ciyaartaa Casaan; midabada kale kombuyuutarka ayaa ciyaara. Tuur laabta: waxaad u baahan tahay 6 si aad xabbad ugu soo saarto gurigeeda, 6 na waxay ku siisaa tuur kale (saddex 6 oo isdaba joog ah waxay ku lumisaa mudadaada). Xabbadaha waxay wareegaan sabuuradda jihada saacadda, kadibna waxay gelaan wadada guriga ee midabkooda; waxaad u baahan tahay tiro sax ah si aad dhamaadka dhexda u gaarto. Ku degidda saxda ah xabbadda khasmiga waxay u celisaa gurigeeda (marka laga reebo square-yada xiddigta iyo bilowga). Ciyaaryahanka marka hore keena dhammaan 4 xabbadood guriga ayaa guulaysta.
ui.lib.arcade.threeSix: Saddex 6 oo isdaba joog ah — waxaad lumisay mudadaada.
ui.lib.arcade.note.pyramid: Ka saar dhammaan 28 kaar ee pyramid-ka. Guji laba kaar oo bannaan (aan kaar kale ku daboolnayn) oo isugeynta ay tahay 13 (A=1, J=11, Q=12) si labadaba loo saaro; Boqorka waxaa keligiis lagu saaraa hal guji. Kaarka sare ee xirmada qashinka sidoo kale waa la isticmaali karaa. Guji xirmada si aad kaar u qaaddo; tirada jeer ee xirmada qashinka dib loo isticmaali karo waa xaddidan tahay.
ui.lib.arcade.note.tripeaks: Ka saar dhammaan 28 kaar ee saddexda qalcad. Guji kaar bannaan oo si sax ah hal darajo uga sarreeya ama uga hooseeya kaarka ka muuqda xirmada qashinka (nooc kasta) si aad hoos ugu dhaqaajiso. Marka dhaqdhaqaaqyadu dhamaadaan, guji xirmada si aad kaar u qaaddo. Heerarka fudud, Boqorku wuxuu ku xirmaa Ace.
ui.lib.arcade.note.golf: Ka saar dhammaan tiirarka. Kaarka hoose ee tiir kasta oo kaliya ayaa la gujin karaa: waa inuu si sax ah hal darajo uga sarreeyaa ama uga hooseeyaa kaarka muuqda. Marka dhaqdhaqaaqyadu dhamaadaan, guji xirmada si aad kaar u qaaddo. Heerarka fudud, Boqorku wuxuu ku xirmaa Ace.
ui.lib.arcade.hnBad: Ma saari kartid saxan weyn mid yar kor.
ui.lib.arcade.fillAll: Fadlan u dooro midab meel kasta.
ui.lib.arcade.note.nonogram: Tirooyinka bilowga safka iyo tiirka kasta waxay si kala horreeya u muujiyaan dhererka kooxaha unugyada buuxsan ee isku xiga ee xariggaas, iyadoo ugu yaraan hal unug oo madhan u dhexeeyo kooxaha. Guji ama jiid si aad unugyada u buuxiso; u beddel “Calaamadee ✕” si aad u xusto unugyada aad hubto inay madhan yihiin. Buuxi tilmaamaha oo dhan si aad u guuleysato.
ui.lib.arcade.note.sokoban: U dhaqaaji ciyaaryahanka furayaasha fallaadhaha/WASD, badhamada hoose ama jiid far. Ku riix sanduuqyada oo dhan unugyada bartilmaameedka (dhibcaha wareegsan). Waxaad riixi kartaa hal sanduuq markiiba mana jiidi kartid, sidaa darteed ka fogow riixidda sanduuqyada geesaha. Isticmaal Ka noqo si aad u hagaajiso dhaqdhaqaaq xun.
ui.lib.arcade.note.block10: Hoos ka dooro qayb, kadibna guji shabakadda si aad u dhigto (qaybaha lama wareejin karo). Buuxi safka ama tiirka oo dhan si loo tirtiro oo aad u hesho dhibco dheeraad ah; tirtirka dhowr xariig isku mar waxay bixisaa bonus weyn. Gaadh dhibcaha bartilmaameedka si aad heerka u dhaafto; haddii aysan qayb ka mid ah kuwa harsan ku habboonayn, waad lumisaa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.dots: Isu beddelka ku xidh laba dhibic oo is-dhow xariig. Ciddii sawirta dhinaca afraad ee afargeesle waxay heshaa (midabkeeda) oo mar kale ciyaartaa. Marka xariiqyada oo dhan la sawiray, ciyaaryahanka leh afargeesle badan ayaa guuleysta. Ha sawirin dhinaca saddexaad ee afargeesle, haddii kale ka soo horjeedkaaga ayaa qaadan doona.
ui.lib.arcade.note.ultimate: Looxa waxaa ka kooban 9 loox yar oo tic-tac-toe ah. Adigu waxaad ciyaartaa X oo waad bilaabaysaa. Unugga aad ka doorato looxa yar ayaa go'aamiya looxa yar ee ka soo horjeedkaagu ku ciyaari doono marka xigta (waa la iftiimiyaa); haddii looxaas hore loo dhammeeyey, wuxuu ku ciyaari karaa meel kasta. Ku guuleyso looxa yar si aad u hesho; hel saddex loox yar safka, tiirka ama dhidibka si aad u ku guuleysato ciyaarta.
ui.lib.arcade.note.lights-out: Gujiska unug wuxuu beddelaa unugga iyo 4-tiisa deriska ah (daar/dami). Dami iftiinka oo dhan. Isticmaal Tilmaan si aad u aragto unug mudan in la riixo.
ui.lib.arcade.note.fifteen: U simbiriirixi taayirrada tirooyinka leh meesha madhan si aad ugu hagaajiso 1, 2, 3… adoo meesha madhan dhigaya geeska hoose ee midig. Guji taayir ku jira safka ama tiirka isku mid ah meesha madhan si aad xariiqda oo dhan u simbiriirixiso; furayaasha fallaadhaha ayaa sidoo kale shaqeeya.
ui.lib.arcade.note.flood-it: Dooro midab si aad ugu buuxiso aagga oo dhan ee aad leedahay geeska sare ee bidix; wuxuu liqaa unugyada deriska ah ee midabkaas leh. Ka dhig looxa oo dhan hal midab gudaha tirada dhaqdhaqaaqyada la oggol yahay.
ui.lib.arcade.note.mastermind: Kombiyuutarku wuxuu qariyaa safka midabbo. Meel kasta dooro midab, kadibna riix Qiyaas. Qodob madow = midab sax ah meel sax ah; qodob cadaan = midab sax ah meel khaldan. Jebi koodhka ka hor inta aysan qiyaasahaagu dhammaan.
ui.lib.arcade.note.hanoi: U wareeji kartidhka oo dhan usha ugu dambeeya. Mar kasta dhaqaaji kartidhka usha ugu sarreeya oo keliya, mana dhigin kartid weyn mid yar kor. Guji usha asalka ah, kadibna usha bartilmaameedka.
ui.lib.arcade.note.pipes: Guji taayir si aad tuubada 90° u wareejiso. Ku xidh tuubooyinka oo dhan shabakad keliya oo aan lahayn dhammaadyo furan (dhammaadyada furan waxay u muuqdaan guduud).

qr-code.desc: Samee QR codes oo loogu talagalay isku-xirayaal, qoraal, Wi-Fi, email iyo lambarada taleefanka. Soo deji sida PNG ama SVG.

utm.name: Dhisaha Isku-xirka UTM
utm.desc: Ku dar koodhadh raadraac ololaha isku-xirayaasha si aad u aragto kanaalka ay ka yimaadaan booqdayaashaadu.

colors.name: Midabaynta & Koodhadhka Midabka
colors.desc: Samee midab-isku-dhis iswaafaqsan oo ka bilaabma midab aasaasi ah oo hel koodhadhka HEX, RGB, HSL iyo doorsoomayaasha CSS.

expense.name: Kharashka & Miisaaniyadda
expense.desc: Diiwaangeli dakhliga iyo kharashka maalinlaha ah, eeg kharashka qaybaha iyo dhig xadayn si aad miisaaniyadda uga hoos joogto.

habit.name: Raadraaca Caadooyinka & Isku-xigxiga
habit.desc: Calaamadi caadooyinka maalin kasta oo la soco isku-xigxiga maalmaha si aad edeb u ilaaliso.

cv.name: Dhisaha Taariikh-nololeedka (CV)
cv.desc: Buuxi qaab-dhismeed adigoo arkaya horudhac toos ah, dooro qaab iyo midab, oo daabac ama ku keydi PDF bilaash.

currency-time.name: Lacagaha & Aagagga Waqtiga
currency-time.desc: U beddel lacagaha iyadoo la raacayo qiimaha ugu dambeeya oo hubi waqtiga magaalooyinka adduunka.

image-resize.name: Beddelaha Cabbirka Sawirka
image-resize.desc: Beddel cabbirka sawirada pixel ama boqolleyda, ilaali saamiga aragga oo habee sawirro badan hal mar.

image-crop.name: Jar Sawirka
image-crop.desc: U jar sawirada si xor ah ama 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 iyo 9:16, oo rogro ama rogrogo ka hor intaadan soo dejin.

image-ocr.name: Sawir ilaa Qoraal (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Ka soo saar qoraalka sawirada, shaashadaha iyo dukumeentiyada la sakaneeyay. Wuxuu taageeraa Ingiriisi iyo 30+ luqadood oo kale.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC ilaa JPG
heic-jpg.desc: U beddel sawirada iPhone ee HEIC JPG ama PNG si ay meel walba u furmaan. Beddelka badan ayaa la taageeraa.

image-upscale.name: Weyneeyaha Sawirka AI
image-upscale.desc: Weynee sawirada 2× ama 4× oo cadee faahfaahinta AI. Aad u fiican sawirada yaryar, ruxruxsan ama duug ah.

image-to-pdf.name: Sawir ilaa PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Ku dar sawirada JPG iyo PNG hal PDF, dib u habee bogagga oo dooro cabbirka warqadda iyo xuduudaha.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF ilaa Sawir
pdf-to-image.desc: U beddel bog PDF kasta JPG ama PNG cad, dooro xallinta, soo deji sawirro keli ah ama ZIP.

pdf-compress.name: Cadee PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Yaree cabbirka faylka PDF ee email-ka iyo foomamka online-ka. Dooro heerka cadaynta oo barbar-dhig cabbirrada.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF ilaa Word
pdf-to-word.desc: U beddel PDF fayl Word (.docx) oo la tafatiri karo, adigoo ilaalinaya qoraalka iyo faqradaha, ama ku hay qaabka bogga sida sawirro.

word-to-pdf.name: Word ilaa PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: U beddel faylasha Word (.docx) PDF browser-kaaga, horudhac eeg, ka dibna soo deji ama daabac.

pdf-sign.name: Saxiix PDF
pdf-sign.desc: Sawir ama qor saxiixaaga, ku dar saxiix sawir ah iyo taariikh, dhig bogagga PDF oo soo deji.

pdf-edit.name: Tafatir PDF & Buuxi Foomamka
pdf-edit.desc: Ku dar qoraal, calaamadaha saxda ah iyo sanduuqyada qarinta PDF-yada oo buuxi goobaha foomamka jira.

case-convert.name: Beddelaha Xarfaha
case-convert.desc: U beddel qoraalka XARFO WAAWEYN, xarfo yaryar, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case iyo wax kale.

fancy-text.name: Abuuraha Qoraalka Qurxoon
fancy-text.desc: U beddel qoraalka caadiga ah 30+ far oo qurux badan oo loogu talagalay Instagram, TikTok, bio-yada Facebook iyo magacyada ciyaaraha. Koobiyee hal taabasho.

text-to-speech.name: Qoraal ilaa Hadal
text-to-speech.desc: Qoraalka kor ugu akhri codadka aaladdaada. Dooro cod, xawaare iyo dhawaaq. Wuxuu taageeraa luqadood badan.

speech-to-text.name: Hadal ilaa Qoraal
speech-to-text.desc: Ku qor codkaaga: ku hadal makarafoonka oo arag qoraalka isla markiiba, ka dibna koobiyee ama soo deji.

scientific-calc.name: Xisaabiyaha Sayniska
scientific-calc.desc: Xisaabiye online ah oo leh trigonometry, logarithms, awoodaha, xididada, factorial, digrii/radiyaan, xusuus iyo taariikh.

percentage.name: Xisaabiyaha Boqolleyda
percentage.desc: Hel X% ee Y, boqolkiiba imisa X ka tahay Y, isbeddelka boqolleyda iyo qiimaha dhimista, oo leh qaacidooyin tallaabo-tallaabo ah.

unit-convert.name: Beddelaha Cutubyada
unit-convert.desc: U beddel dhererka, miisaanka, heerkulka, aagga, mugga, xawaaraha, waqtiga, xogta, cadaadiska iyo tamarta.

age-calc.name: Xisaabiyaha Da'da
age-calc.desc: Xisaabi da'da saxda ah sannado, bilo iyo maalmo, wadarta maalmaha la noolaa, dhalashada xigta iyo calaamadda xiddigta.

date-calc.name: Xisaabiyaha Taariikhda
date-calc.desc: Tiri maalmaha u dhexeeya laba taariikh, ku dar ama ka jar maalmo, toddobaadyo, bilo iyo sannado, oo arag maalinta usbuuca.

gpa.name: Xisaabiyaha GPA
gpa.desc: Xisaabi GPA-ga kal-fadhiga iyo isugeynta iyadoo la raacayo saacadaha credit-ka ee cabbirka 4.0 oo leh darajooyin xarfo ah.

due-date.name: Xisaabiyaha Taariikhda Dhalmada
due-date.desc: Qiyaas taariikhda dhalmada iyo usbuuca uurka caadadii ugu dambeysay, taariikhda uuraysiga ama ultrasound-ka, oo leh heerarka muhiimka ah.

spin-wheel.name: Wareeji Giraangiraha
spin-wheel.desc: Samee giraangirhe leh magacyo ama abaalmarino kasta, ku wareeji si cadaalad ah oo aan kala sooc lahayn, ka saar guulaystayaasha, habka shaashadda buuxda.

random-number.name: Abuuraha Lambarka Aan Kala Sooc Lahayn
random-number.desc: Samee lambaro aan kala sooc lahayn xad kasta, dhowr hal mar, oo leh ama aan lahayn nuqul, loogu talagalay sabaqyada iyo ciyaaraha.

typing-test.name: Imtixaanka Xawaaraha Qorista
typing-test.desc: Cabbir xawaaraha qorista (WPM) iyo saxnaanta 30 ilbiriqsi ilaa 5 daqiiqo.

cps-test.name: Imtixaanka CPS (Xawaaraha Riixista)
cps-test.desc: Tiri riixitaannada ilbiriqsi kasta 1 ilaa 60 ilbiriqsi, ilaali dhibcahaaga ugu fiican, tijaabi spacebar iyo taabashada.

webcam-test.name: Imtixaanka Webcam-ka
webcam-test.desc: Hubi in kamarada shaqeyso, arag xallinta iyo xawaaraha fireemada, beddel kamarooyinka oo qaado sawir tijaabo ah.

screen-recorder.name: Duubaha Shaashadda
screen-recorder.desc: Duub shaashaddaada, daaqad ama tab leh codka nidaamka iyo makarafoonka, rakibid looma baahna.

video-compress.name: Cadeeyaha Muuqaalka
video-compress.desc: Yaree faylasha MP4, MOV iyo WebM ee fariimaha, email-ka iyo baraha bulshada. Dooro xallinta iyo tayada.

video-to-mp3.name: Muuqaal ilaa MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Ka soo saar codka muuqaallada MP4, MOV iyo WebM sida MP3, dooro tayada oo jar qaybta aad u baahan tahay.

guitar-tuner.name: Hagaajiyaha Gitaarka
guitar-tuner.desc: Hagaaji gitaarka, ukulele iyo bass makarafoonkaaga: nootada, farqiga cents iyo ilaha, oo ay weheliyaan codadka tixraaca.

password-gen.name: Abuuraha Erayga Sirta ah
password-gen.desc: Samee erayo sir ah oo xoog leh oo aan kala sooc lahayn ama weedho sir ah oo la xasuusan karo, dooro dhererka iyo xarfaha, hubi xoogga.

signature.name: Samaha Saxiixa
signature.desc: Sawir saxiixaaga jiirka ama far, ama ku qor fartiisa gacanta; soo deji PNG hufan.

logo-maker.name: Samaha Summadda
logo-maker.desc: Samee summad ka timaadda icon, magaca summadda iyo shiraac; dooro far, midabyo iyo qaab, soo deji SVG ama PNG.

notepad.name: Buug-xusuuseedka Online
notepad.desc: Qoraallo degdeg ah oo si toos ah browser-kaaga ugu keydsan: qoraallo badan, raadin, tirinta erayada iyo soo dejinta TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Ka buuxi Word Excel
excel-word-fill.desc: Waxay ka qaadataa nuxur fayl Excel ah oo gelisaa calaamadaha fayl Word, iyadoo cinwaannada tirakoobka leh ay ka muuqdaan casaan.

excel-cell-merge.name: Isku dar unugyada Excel ee xaashiyo / faylal badan
excel-cell-merge.desc: Waxay isku darsaa isla unugga (A1, B2...) ee xaashiyo ama faylal Excel oo badan hal unug, iyadoo digniin la siinayo unugyada xog ku leh in ka badan hal ilo.

excel-row-concat.name: Isu dheji safafka Excel ee xaashiyo / faylal badan
excel-row-concat.desc: Waxay isu dhejisaa xaashiyo ama faylal Excel oo badan hoos hal miis dheer. Waxay madaxa ka dhigtaa hal mar waxayna ka saartaa safafka bannaan.

excel-formula-merge.name: Ku dar xogta Excel foomulooyin
excel-formula-merge.desc: Waxay isku darsaa xaashiyo ama faylal Excel oo badan iyadoo foomulo unug kasta loo isticmaalayo (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), shaqooyin gudaha ah, iyo foomulooyin la keydiyay oo dib loo isticmaali karo.

sudoku-9x9.name: Sudoku 9x9
sudoku-9x9.desc: Ku ciyaar Sudoku 9x9 khadka 10 heer oo ka bilaabma fudud ilaa adag, leh qoraallo, tilmaamo iyo hubinta khaladaadka.

sudoku-16x16.name: Sudoku 16x16
sudoku-16x16.desc: Sudoku weyn 16x16 oo isticmaalaya 1-9 iyo A-G, 10 heer oo fudud ilaa adag, leh qoraallo iyo tilmaamo.

chess.name: Jees
chess.desc: Ku ciyaar jees kombiyuutarka 10 heer ama onlayn: casuun saaxiib xiriir ku dir ama la ciyaar qof cusub. Leh castling, en passant iyo dallacaad.

xiangqi.name: Xiangqi (jees Shiinees)
xiangqi.desc: Ku ciyaar Xiangqi kombiyuutarka 10 heer ama onlayn: casuun saaxiib xiriir ku dir ama la ciyaar qof cusub. Xeerar dhammaystiran: lugta faraska, isha maroodiga, boodka madfaca iyo jeneraalada aan is arki karin.

go-game.name: Go
go-game.desc: Ku ciyaar Go kombiyuutarka 10 heer ama onlayn sabuuradaha 9x9, 13x13 iyo 19x19 saaxiib ama ka soo horjeede cusub. Tirin toos ah dhammaadka.

memory-shapes.name: Xusuusta Qaabka & Midabka
memory-shapes.desc: Taayilo leh qaabab iyo midabbo ayaa la muujiyaa 5 ilbiriqsi, kaddibna waa la qariyaa; xusuuso oo dooro taayilka saxda ah, 10 heer oo fudud ilaa adag.

web-desktop.name: Desktop onlayn ah
web-desktop.desc: Desktop kombiyuutar oo biraawsarkaaga ku jira: maamulaha faylasha, Notepad, daawade sawir iyo PDF, xisaabiye, kalandar iyo qashin. Faylasha waxaa lagu kaydiyaa Google Drive-kaaga.

co-up.name: Xiangqi qarsoon
co-up.desc: Ciyaar Xiangqi qarsoon ee Fiyetnaam: xabbaduhu waxay ku bilaabmaan iyagoo wejiga hoos u jeeda waxaana la rogaa kadib dhaqdhaqaaqa koowaad. Kombiyuutarka 10 heer ama onlayn saaxiibo iyo ka soo horjeedayaal cusub.

game-2048.desc: Jiid oo isku dar nambarada isku midka ah ilaa aad ka samayso tiirka 2048; 10 heer oo bartilmaameedyadoodu yihiin 64 ilaa 8192, oo leh dib-u-celin.

minesweeper.name: Raadiyaha miinooyinka
minesweeper.desc: Raadiyaha miinooyinka caadiga ah: fur unugyada, dhig calammo oo nambarada ka garo halka ay miinooyinku ku jiraan; 10 heer laga bilaabo 8x8 ilaa 18x18, wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa taleefannada.

block-puzzle.name: Baloogyada dhacaya
block-puzzle.desc: Wareeji oo is dul saar baloogyada dhacaya si aad u nadiifiso xariiqyada; 10 heer oo sii dhakhsaynaya, kiiboodh ama badhamada taabashada.

snake.name: Abeeso
snake.desc: Hag abeesada si ay wax u cunto oo u korto iyadoo ka fogaanaysa derbiyada iyo dabadeeda; 10 heer oo dhakhso ah oo leh caqabado.

solitaire.name: Solitaire
solitaire.desc: Klondike Solitaire-ka caadiga ah: hoos u dhis adigoo midabada isweydaarsanaya oo kaararka u guuri saldhigyada A ilaa K; soo qaado 1 ama 3, oo leh dib-u-celin iyo talooyin.

spider-solitaire.name: Solitaire Caaro
spider-solitaire.desc: Caaro leh 1, 2 iyo 4 nooc: dhis taxane isku nooc ah K ilaa A si aad miiska uga saarto; 10 heer oo leh dib-u-celin iyo talooyin.

freecell.name: FreeCell
freecell.desc: FreeCell Solitaire: dhammaan kaararku way furan yihiin; isticmaal unugyada bannaan si aad kaararka ugu guuriso saldhigyada; 10 heer oo unugyadu sii yaraanayaan.

gomoku.name: Gomoku (shan saf ah)
gomoku.desc: Ciyaar Gomoku, shan saf ah, adigoo ka soo horjeeda kombiyuutarka sabuuradda 15x15; 10 heer laga bilaabo fudud ilaa adag, oo leh dib-u-celin.

reversi.name: Reversi
reversi.desc: Xannib saxannada ka soo horjeedaha si ay midabkaaga ugu rogmadaan; ciyaar Reversi 8x8 oo ka dhan ah kombiyuutarka 10 heer.

connect-four.name: Afar saf ah
connect-four.desc: Saxannada ku rid tiirarka oo saf ka dhig 4 jiif, taagan ama xagal ka hor kombiyuutarka; 10 heer laga bilaabo fudud ilaa adag.

match-3.name: Isku keen 3
match-3.desc: Isweydaarsii nacnaca si aad isugu keento 3 ama ka badan oo isku mid ah oo aad u kiciso falcelin silsilad ah; 10 heer oo leh dhibco bartilmaameed iyo dhaqaaqyo xaddidan.

brick-breaker.name: Burburiyaha leebka
brick-breaker.desc: Hag sabuuradda oo kubadda ka boodi si aad u burburiso leeb kasta; 10 marxaladood oo qaabab kala duwan leh, jiir, taabasho ama furayaal.

pyramid.name: Pyramid Solitaire
pyramid.desc: Ka saar pyramid-ka 28 kaar adigoo isku qabanaya kaararka isugeyntoodu tahay 13; 10 heer oo harsan oo dib u qaybin yaraanaya.

tripeaks.name: TriPeaks Solitaire
tripeaks.desc: Ka saar saddex qalcad adigoo isku xirayo kaararka hal darajo ku kala duwan; 10 heer oo fudud ilaa adag.

golf.name: Golf Solitaire
golf.desc: Ka saar tiirarka adigoo isku xirayo kaararka hal darajo uga duwan kaarka muuqda; 10 heer oo tiirar badan marka aad horumarto.

blackjack.name: Blackjack
blackjack.desc: Ku ciyaar blackjack qaybiyaha jeetooyin virtual ah: u dhowaw 21 adigoon dhaafin; laban laab oo kala qaybi; 10 heer oo bartilmaameedyo jeeto kordhaya leh.

video-poker.name: Video Poker
video-poker.desc: Poker shan kaar ee beddelka leh oo jeetooyin virtual ah (Jacks ama ka wanaagsan); 10 heer oo jadwalyo lacag-bixin ka adag leh.

checkers.name: Checkers
checkers.desc: Ku ciyaar checkers 8x8 kombuyuutarka: qabasho khasab ah, boodo badan iyo boqorro; 10 heer oo fudud ilaa adag.

ludo.name: Ludo
ludo.desc: Ciyaar tartan ah oo afar midab leh: tuur laabta oo keen 4-ta xabbadood guriga marka hore; la ciyaar 1 ilaa 3 ciyaaryahan kombuyuutar 10 heer ah gudahood.

o-an-quan.name: Ô ăn quan
o-an-quan.desc: Ciyaar dhaqameed Vietnam oo beerista dhagaxyada ah: beer dhagaxyada oo qabo Mandarin-ka kombuyuutarka; 10 heer oo fudud ilaa adag.

lights-out.name: Lights Out
lights-out.desc: Dami iftiinka oo dhan: riix kasta wuxuu rogaa unugga iyo 4-tiisa deriska ah; 10 heer oo leh looxyo kordhaya iyo badhan tilmaan.

fifteen.name: Ciyaarta 15 (halxiraale simbiriirixa)
fifteen.desc: U simbiriirixi taayirrada tirooyinka leh si ay u kala horreeyaan; 10 heer laga bilaabo 3x3 ilaa 5x5, lagu ciyaaro mouse, taabasho ama furayaasha fallaadhaha.

flood-it.name: Flood-it
flood-it.desc: Buuxi looxa geeska ka bilaabo ilaa uu noqdo hal midab gudaha dhaqdhaqaaqyo xaddidan; 10 heer oo leh looxyo waaweyn iyo midabbo badan.

mastermind.name: Mastermind (jebiyaha koodhka)
mastermind.desc: Jebi koodhka midabka ee qarsoon adigoo isticmaalaya tilmaamaha qodobbada madow iyo cadaan; 10 heer oo leh koodhyo dhaadheer iyo midabbo badan.

hanoi.name: Munaaraddii Hanoi
hanoi.desc: U wareeji kartidhka usha ugu horreysa ilaa tan ugu dambeysa adoon kartid weyn mid yar kor dhigin; 10 heer laga bilaabo 3 kartid ilaa 12 kartid 4 usha ah.

pipes.name: Ku xidh Tuubooyinka
pipes.desc: Wareeji qaybaha tuubooyinka si aad ugu xidho shabakad keliya oo aan lahayn dhammaadyo furan; 10 heer oo leh looxyo kordhaya.

nonogram.name: Nonogram (Picross)
nonogram.desc: Buuxi unugyada adigoo isticmaalaya tilmaamaha tirooyinka ee safafka iyo tiirarka si aad sawir u muujiso; 10 heer laga bilaabo 5x5 ilaa 15x15.

sokoban.name: Sokoban (riixaha sanduuqyada)
sokoban.desc: Ku riix sanduuqyada unugyada bartilmaameedka bakhaar ku jira; heer kasta waa la xallin karaa, 10 heer oo leh sanduuqyo badan iyo bakhaarro waaweyn.

block-10x10.name: Halxiraalaha Block 10x10
block-10x10.desc: Ku dhig qaybaha shabakad 10x10 oo buuxi safaf ama tiirar si loo tirtiro oo aad u gaadho dhibcaha bartilmaameedka; 10 heer.

dots-boxes.name: Dhibco iyo Sanduuqyo
dots-boxes.desc: Isu beddelka ku xidh dhibcaha si aad u hesho afargeesle oo kombiyuutarka ku garaac 10 heer laga bilaabo sahlan ilaa adag.

ultimate-tictactoe.name: Tic-Tac-Toe Ugu Dambeeya
ultimate-tictactoe.desc: Tic-tac-toe 9 loox yar: unugga aad doorato ayaa go'aamiya meesha ka soo horjeedkaagu ku ciyaari doono; ka dhan ah kombiyuutarka 10 heer.

bg-remove.drop.title: Dooro sawir ama halkan ku riix
bg-remove.drop.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Ugu fiican sawirada alaabta ee leh gadaal cad ama midab keliya ah. Sawirada waxaa lagu habeeyaa aaladdaada.

attendance.add.ph: Qor magac oo taabo Enter (mid xariiq kasta marka laga xerayo badan)

attendance.note: Riix unugga xaaladda si aad ugu wareejiso: Jooga → Maqan → Daahay → Cudurdaar leh. Tiirarka soo-koobidda waxay tirinayaan taariikhda oo dhan. Ku gal Google si aad ugu keydiso Google Sheets.

barcode.mw.label: Ballaca bar-ka
barcode.h.label: Dhererka bar-ka

rsa-keys.note: Wax walba waxay ka shaqeeyaan browser-kaaga iyagoo adeegsanaya Web Crypto, meel looma dirayo. Maadaama RSA uu si toos ah u qarsan karo xog aad u gaaban oo kaliya, qalabku wuxuu isticmaalaa qarsoodi-bixin isku-dhafan: wuxuu abuuraa fure AES oo aan kala sooc lahayn si uu qoraalka u qarsado, ka dibna furahaas AES wuxuu ku duubaa RSA — sidaa darteed qoraal dherer kasta ah waa la qarsan karaa. Qaataha wuxuu u baahan yahay furaha gaarka ah ee ku habboon si uu u furfuro. Furaha dadweynaha (SPKI) waa la wadaagi karaa; furaha gaarka ah (PKCS#8) waa in sir loo hayaa.

Halkan ku qor qoraalladaada. Isbeddel kasta si toos ah ayaa loogu keydiyaa browser-kan.

notepad.full: Kaydka browser-ku waa buuxaa. Soo deji oo tirtir qoraallo duug ah.

notepad.tooBig: Faylku wuu ka weyn yahay 2 MB lamana furi karo buug-xusuuseedka.
